description: Full structured JSON state of a board: texts (id, x, y, content, color, width, postit, author), strokes (id, points, color, author), images (id, x, y, width, height, dataUrl, thumbDataUrl, author; heavy base64 >8 kB elided to dataUrl:null, tiny images inlined). Use this for EXACT ids/coordinates/content (needed for `move`, `erase`, editing a text by id). For visual layout (where is empty space? what overlaps?) call `get_preview` instead. A qualifying read refreshes the board's inactivity retention timestamp.

access_key.description: Board key for direct MCP clients that handle credentials outside chat. Accepts an 8-character key or a legacy 6-character key. Keep the key out of chat and use the browser or an MCP client configured with the X-Board-Key header.

name: get_board
title: Get Board
